description: Detects creation of a kernel-mode service whose name or ImagePath impersonates Kaspersky, Riot Vanguard (Valorant/vgk), Javelin or WatchDog — the GentleKiller BYOVD masquerade — when the driver does not reside under the legitimate vendor path.
references:
  - https://www.bleepingcomputer.com/news/security/gentlemen-ransomware-uses-multiple-edr-killers-to-disable-defenses/
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/06/19
tags:
  - attack.t1068
  - attack.t1543.003
  - attack.t1036.005
  - attack.defense_evasion
  - attack.privilege_escalation
logsource:
  product: windows
  service: system
detection:
  selection_eid:
    Provider_Name: 'Service Control Manager'
    EventID: 7045
  selection_kernel:
    ServiceType|contains: 'kernel'
  selection_name:
    - ServiceName|contains:
        - 'kaspersky'
        - 'valorant'
        - 'vgk'
        - 'javelin'
        - 'watchdog'
        - 'wdog'
    - ImagePath|contains:
        - 'kaspersky'
        - 'valorant'
        - 'vgk.sys'
        - 'javelin'
        - 'watchdog'
  filter_legit:
    ImagePath|contains:
      - '\Program Files\Kaspersky Lab\'
      - '\Program Files\Riot Vanguard\'
      - '\Program Files\Valorant\'
  condition: selection_eid and selection_kernel and selection_name and not filter_legit
level: high
2532.spl: | tstats `summariesonly` count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(Registry.registry_value_data) as ImagePath values(Registry.process_name) as parent from datamodel=Endpoint.Registry where Registry.registry_path="*\\System\\CurrentControlSet\\Services\\*\\ImagePath" (Registry.registry_value_data="*kaspersky*" OR Registry.registry_value_data="*valorant*" OR Registry.registry_value_data="*vgk*" OR Registry.registry_value_data="*javelin*" OR Registry.registry_value_data="*watchdog*" OR Registry.registry_path="*\\Services\\kaspersky*" OR Registry.registry_path="*\\Services\\valorant*" OR Registry.registry_path="*\\Services\\vgk*" OR Registry.registry_path="*\\Services\\javelin*" OR Registry.registry_path="*\\Services\\watchdog*") by Registry.dest Registry.user Registry.registry_path Registry.registry_value_data | `drop_dm_object_name(Registry)` | where NOT match(ImagePath, "(?i)\\\\Program Files\\\\(Kaspersky Lab|Riot Vanguard|Valorant)\\\\") | convert ctime(firstTime) ctime(lastTime)
2532.datadog: source:windows.sysmon @EventID:13 @TargetObject:(*\\System\\CurrentControlSet\\Services\\* OR *\\system\\currentcontrolset\\services\\*) (@Details:(*kaspersky* OR *Kaspersky* OR *KASPERSKY* OR *valorant* OR *Valorant* OR *VALORANT* OR *vgk.sys* OR *VGK.sys* OR *javelin* OR *Javelin* OR *JAVELIN* OR *watchdog* OR *WatchDog* OR *WATCHDOG*) OR @TargetObject:(*\\Services\\kaspersky* OR *\\Services\\Kaspersky* OR *\\Services\\valorant* OR *\\Services\\Valorant* OR *\\Services\\vgk* OR *\\Services\\Javelin* OR *\\Services\\WatchDog* OR *\\Services\\watchdog*)) -@Details:(*\\Program\ Files\\Kaspersky\ Lab\\* OR *\\Program\ Files\\Riot\ Vanguard\\* OR *\\Program\ Files\\Valorant\\*)
2532.falcon: #event_simpleName=AsepValueUpdate | RegObjectName=/\\System\\CurrentControlSet\\Services\\/i | RegValueName=/ImagePath/i | RegStringValue=/(kaspersky|valorant|vgk\.sys|javelin|watchdog|wdog|wsdk)/i | NOT RegStringValue=/\\Program Files\\(Kaspersky Lab|Riot Vanguard|Valorant)\\/i | groupBy([aid, ComputerName, RegObjectName, RegStringValue, ContextImageFileName], function=count())

2533.def:
let MasqNames = dynamic(["kaspersky","avp","avpui","valorant","vgc","vgk","javelin","watchdog","wdog"]);
let SuspectPaths = dynamic([@"\Users\Public\", @"\ProgramData\", @"\Windows\Temp\", @"\PerfLogs\", @"\AppData\Local\Temp\", @"\Downloads\"]);
let LegitPaths = dynamic([@"\Program Files\Kaspersky Lab\", @"\Program Files\Riot Vanguard\", @"\Program Files\Valorant\", @"\Program Files (x86)\Kaspersky Lab\"]);
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(14d)
| where AccountName !endswith "$"
| extend FNameLow = tolower(FileName)
| where FNameLow has_any (MasqNames)
| where FolderPath has_any (SuspectPaths)
| where not (FolderPath has_any (LegitPaths))
| extend SignerSuspect = (not(ProcessVersionInfoCompanyName has_any ("Kaspersky","Riot Games","Microsoft"))) or isempty(ProcessVersionInfoCompanyName)
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, FileName, FolderPath, SHA256, SHA1,
          ProcessCommandLine, ProcessVersionInfoCompanyName, ProcessVersionInfoProductName, ProcessVersionInfoOriginalFileName,
          InitiatingProcessFileName, InitiatingProcessCommandLine, SignerSuspect
| order by Timestamp desc
2533.sent:
let MasqNames = dynamic(["kaspersky","avp","avpui","valorant","vgc","vgk","javelin","watchdog","wdog"]);
let SuspectPaths = dynamic([@"\Users\Public\", @"\ProgramData\", @"\Windows\Temp\", @"\PerfLogs\", @"\AppData\Local\Temp\", @"\Downloads\"]);
let LegitPaths = dynamic([@"\Program Files\Kaspersky Lab\", @"\Program Files\Riot Vanguard\", @"\Program Files\Valorant\"]);
SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(14d)
| where EventID == 4688
| extend FNameLow = tolower(NewProcessName)
| where FNameLow has_any (MasqNames)
| where FNameLow has_any (SuspectPaths)
| where not (FNameLow has_any (LegitPaths))
| where AccountName !endswith "$"
| project TimeGenerated, Computer, SubjectUserName, NewProcessName, CommandLine, ParentProcessName
| order by TimeGenerated desc

title: Gentlemen GentleKiller Masquerade Binary from User-Writable Path
id: 9c3e8a7b-4b1a-4d62-8aa3-2f6d4b1c9a03
description: Detects execution of a binary whose name impersonates Kaspersky, Riot Valorant/Vanguard, Javelin or WatchDog from a user-writable directory (Temp/Public/ProgramData/Downloads) — the GentleKiller masquerade footprint when hashes have rotated.
references:
  - https://www.bleepingcomputer.com/news/security/gentlemen-ransomware-uses-multiple-edr-killers-to-disable-defenses/
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/06/19
tags:
  - attack.t1036.005
  - attack.t1027.002
  - attack.defense_evasion
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection_name:
    Image|endswith:
      - '\kaspersky.exe'
      - '\avp.exe'
      - '\avpui.exe'
      - '\valorant.exe'
      - '\vgc.exe'
      - '\vgk.exe'
      - '\javelin.exe'
      - '\watchdog.exe'
      - '\wdog.exe'
  selection_path:
    Image|contains:
      - '\Users\Public\'
      - '\ProgramData\'
      - '\Windows\Temp\'
      - '\PerfLogs\'
      - '\AppData\Local\Temp\'
      - '\Downloads\'
  filter_legit:
    Image|contains:
      - '\Program Files\Kaspersky Lab\'
      - '\Program Files\Riot Vanguard\'
      - '\Program Files\Valorant\'
  condition: selection_name and selection_path and not filter_legit
level: medium

2536.sigma:
title: Gemini-MCP-tool @file exfiltration of sensitive paths (CVE-2026-0755)
id: 9c8d7e2a-1f4b-4a6c-8d3e-2b1f5e7a9c4d
description: Detects gemini-mcp-tool invoking Gemini CLI with @-prefixed references to sensitive files indicating CVE-2026-0755 exploitation
references:
  - https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-4h5r-5jm8-jxjm
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/06/19
tags:
  - attack.t1005
  - attack.t1552.004
  - attack.collection
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection_parent:
    ParentImage|endswith:
      - '\node.exe'
      - '\npx.exe'
  selection_sensitive:
    CommandLine|contains:
      - '@/etc/passwd'
      - '@~/.ssh/'
      - '@/root/'
      - '@/proc/self/'
      - '@../'
      - 'id_rsa'
      - '.aws\credentials'
      - '.env'
  selection_at:
    CommandLine|contains: '@'
  condition: selection_parent and selection_sensitive and selection_at
falsepositives:
  - Developers legitimately referencing files with these names via @file
level: high

2538.def:
let TinyPulseApps = dynamic(["TinyPulse","tinypulse","WebMD","webmd","WebMD Health Services"]);
let BulkOps = dynamic(["Export","BulkDownload","MassDownload","DownloadFile","ExportToCsv","ExportData","DownloadReport"]);
let SignInAnomaly = AADSignInEventsBeta
  | where Timestamp > ago(30d)
  | where Application has_any (TinyPulseApps) or ApplicationId has_any (TinyPulseApps)
  | where ErrorCode == 0
  | summarize SignInCount = count(),
              Countries = make_set(Country, 10),
              IPs = make_set(IPAddress, 25),
              FirstSeen = min(Timestamp), LastSeen = max(Timestamp)
              by AccountUpn, Application
  | where array_length(Countries) > 2 or SignInCount > 200
  | extend Signal = "cross-geo or volumetric sign-in";
let BulkExport = CloudAppEvents
  | where Timestamp > ago(30d)
  | where Application has_any (TinyPulseApps)
  | where ActionType has_any (BulkOps)
     or (ActivityType has_any ("download","export","bulk") and isnotempty(ObjectName))
  | summarize EventCount = count(),
              Objects = make_set(ObjectName, 25),
              Countries = make_set(CountryCode, 10),
              IPs = make_set(IPAddress, 10),
              FirstSeen = min(Timestamp), LastSeen = max(Timestamp)
              by AccountDisplayName, Application, ActionType
  | extend Signal = "bulk export against TinyPulse";
SignInAnomaly
| union BulkExport
| order by LastSeen desc

    | where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackDays)
    | project TimeGenerated, Host = Computer, ClientIP = cIP, User = csUserName, Method = csMethod, Path = csUriStem, Status = scStatus, UA = csUserAgent);
let Enum = WebReq
  | where Method == "GET"
  | where Path matches regex @"^/[0-9a-fA-F-]{36}/members/?$"
  | where Status between (200 .. 299)
  | extend WorkspaceId = extract(@"^/([0-9a-fA-F-]{36})/members", 1, Path)
  | project EnumTime = TimeGenerated, EnumClientIP = ClientIP, EnumUser = User, EnumUA = UA, EnumHost = Host, WorkspaceId;
let Destruct = WebReq
  | where Method == "DELETE"
  | where Path matches regex @"^/workspaces/[0-9a-fA-F-]{36}/?$"
      or Path matches regex @"^/[0-9a-fA-F-]{36}/members/[0-9a-fA-F-]{36}/?$"
  | extend WorkspaceId = coalesce(extract(@"/workspaces/([0-9a-fA-F-]{36})", 1, Path), extract(@"^/([0-9a-fA-F-]{36})/members/", 1, Path))
  | project DestructTime = TimeGenerated, DestructClientIP = ClientIP, DestructUser = User, DestructUA = UA, DestructHost = Host, DestructPath = Path, WorkspaceId;
Enum

| order by DestructTime desc

Under GHSA-x227-pf99-vffg, the SSE transport ignores the bundled SecurityConfig — any reachable client can drive tools/call without auth, and if a shell/file/code-exec tool is registered this is the on-host signature.
references:
  - https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-x227-pf99-vffg
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/06/18
tags:
  - attack.execution
  - attack.t1059
  - attack.t1059.001
  - attack.t1059.003
  - attack.t1059.004
  - attack.t1190
logsource:
  category: process_creation
detection:
  selection_parent:
    ParentImage|endswith:
      - '\python.exe'
      - '\pythonw.exe'
      - '\python3.exe'
      - '/python'
      - '/python3'
      - '/uvicorn'
      - '\uvicorn.exe'
    ParentCommandLine|contains: 'praisonaiagents'
  selection_child:
    Image|endswith:
      - '\cmd.exe'
      - '\powershell.exe'
      - '\pwsh.exe'
      - '\wscript.exe'
      - '\cscript.exe'
      - '\mshta.exe'
      - '\certutil.exe'
      - '\bitsadmin.exe'
      - '\whoami.exe'
      - '\net.exe'
      - '\net1.exe'
      - '\nltest.exe'
      - '\schtasks.exe'
      - '\reg.exe'
      - '\rundll32.exe'
      - '\regsvr32.exe'
      - '\curl.exe'
      - '\wget.exe'
      - '/bash'
      - '/sh'
      - '/zsh'
      - '/whoami'
      - '/curl'
      - '/wget'
      - '/nc'
      - '/ncat'
  condition: selection_parent and selection_child
falsepositives:
  - PraisonAI deployment that legitimately registers a system/shell tool (rare — should be reviewed)
  - Built-in tool that shells out for git/pip lookups during agent runtime
level: critical

2629.def:
// Article-specific bespoke detection — DragonForce Hackers Abuse Microsoft Teams Relays to Hide Backdoor.Turn C2 Traffi
// Hunts the actual binaries / paths / commandline fragments named
// in the article instead of a generic technique-class template.
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(30d)
| where (FileName in~ ("hwauidoos2ec.sys", "wsftprm.sys", "gamedriverx64.sys", "k7rkscan.sys", "dbgview64.exe"))
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, FileName,
          FolderPath, ProcessCommandLine,
          InitiatingProcessFileName, InitiatingProcessCommandLine
| order by Timestamp desc

// File-creation events for the named binaries / paths
DeviceFileEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(30d)
| where ActionType in ("FileCreated","FileModified")
| where (FileName in~ ("hwauidoos2ec.sys", "wsftprm.sys", "gamedriverx64.sys", "k7rkscan.sys", "dbgview64.exe"))
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, FolderPath,
          FileName, ActionType, InitiatingProcessFileName,
          InitiatingProcessCommandLine
| order by Timestamp desc
2629.spl:
``` Article-specific bespoke detection — DragonForce Hackers Abuse Microsoft Teams Relays to Hide Backdoor.Turn C2 Traffi ```
| tstats `summariesonly` count earliest(_time) AS firstTime latest(_time) AS lastTime
    from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes
    where (Processes.process_name IN ("hwauidoos2ec.sys","wsftprm.sys","gamedriverx64.sys","k7rkscan.sys","dbgview64.exe"))
    by Processes.dest, Processes.user, Processes.process_name,
       Processes.process, Processes.parent_process_name, Processes.process_path
| `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)`
| `security_content_ctime(firstTime)`
| append [
| tstats `summariesonly` count
    from datamodel=Endpoint.Filesystem
    where Filesystem.action IN ("created","modified")
      AND (Filesystem.file_name IN ("hwauidoos2ec.sys","wsftprm.sys","gamedriverx64.sys","k7rkscan.sys","dbgview64.exe"))
    by Filesystem.dest, Filesystem.user, Filesystem.process_name,
       Filesystem.file_path, Filesystem.file_name
| `drop_dm_object_name(Filesystem)`
]

| where Timestamp > ago(30d)
| where ActionType in ("CreateRemoteThreadApiCall","OpenProcessApiCall","ProcessPrimaryTokenModified","WriteToLsassProcessMemory")
| extend TargetImage = tostring(parse_json(AdditionalFields).TargetImage),
         TargetFileName_x = tostring(parse_json(AdditionalFields).TargetFileName)

| where Provider == "Microsoft-Windows-Sysmon"
| where EventID in (8, 10)
| extend TargetImage = tostring(EventData.TargetImage),

2651.def:
// Article-specific bespoke detection — Miasma and Hades Are Spreading Now: Detect Them on Developer Machines with Suspi
// Hunts the actual binaries / paths / commandline fragments named
// in the article instead of a generic technique-class template.
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(30d)
| where (FileName in~ ("__init__.py"))
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, FileName,
          FolderPath, ProcessCommandLine,
          InitiatingProcessFileName, InitiatingProcessCommandLine
| order by Timestamp desc

// File-creation events for the named binaries / paths
DeviceFileEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(30d)
| where ActionType in ("FileCreated","FileModified")
| where (FileName in~ ("__init__.py"))
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, FolderPath,
          FileName, ActionType, InitiatingProcessFileName,
          InitiatingProcessCommandLine
| order by Timestamp desc
2651.spl:
``` Article-specific bespoke detection — Miasma and Hades Are Spreading Now: Detect Them on Developer Machines with Suspi ```
| tstats `summariesonly` count earliest(_time) AS firstTime latest(_time) AS lastTime
    from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes
    where (Processes.process_name IN ("__init__.py"))
    by Processes.dest, Processes.user, Processes.process_name,
       Processes.process, Processes.parent_process_name, Processes.process_path
| `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)`
| `security_content_ctime(firstTime)`
| append [
| tstats `summariesonly` count
    from datamodel=Endpoint.Filesystem
    where Filesystem.action IN ("created","modified")
      AND (Filesystem.file_name IN ("__init__.py"))
    by Filesystem.dest, Filesystem.user, Filesystem.process_name,
       Filesystem.file_path, Filesystem.file_name
| `drop_dm_object_name(Filesystem)`
]

2656.def:
DeviceFileEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(7d)
| where FileName =~ "__init__.py"
| where FolderPath has "\\site-packages\\"
| where ActionType in ("FileCreated","FileModified")
| where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ ("pip.exe","pip3.exe","python.exe","python3.exe","pythonw.exe","py.exe","uv.exe","poetry.exe","conda.exe")

id: b8e3facd-4f9c-4f2b-ac7f-3d6e9f8a2b5c
description: Detects tailscale.exe/tailscaled.exe execution or tailnet bootstrap commands on a Windows endpoint, per Cato CTRL's hunt for 'Poisson's' Tailscale fallback channel.
references:
  - https://thehackernews.com/2026/06/junior-hacker-used-tailscale-and.html
author: thn-usecases
date: 2026/06/17
tags:
  - attack.t1572
  - attack.t1219
  - attack.t1090
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection_bin:
    Image|endswith:
      - '\tailscale.exe'
      - '\tailscaled.exe'
  selection_cmd:
    CommandLine|contains:
      - 'tailscale up'
      - 'tailscale login'
      - '--authkey'
      - '--login-server'
  condition: 1 of selection_*
level: high
2693.spl: | tstats summariesonly=t count from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where (Processes.process_name=tailscale.exe OR Processes.process_name=tailscaled.exe OR Processes.process="*tailscale*up*" OR Processes.process="*tailscale*login*") by host Processes.user Processes.process_name Processes.process Processes.parent_process_name | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | append [| tstats summariesonly=t count from datamodel=Network_Traffic.All_Traffic where All_Traffic.dest_ip=100.64.0.0/10 OR All_Traffic.dest="login.tailscale.com" OR All_Traffic.dest="controlplane.tailscale.com" OR All_Traffic.dest_port=41641 by All_Traffic.src All_Traffic.dest All_Traffic.dest_ip All_Traffic.dest_port All_Traffic.app | `drop_dm_object_name(All_Traffic)`] | sort - count
2693.datadog: source:(windows.security OR windows.sysmon) (@Image:(*\tailscale.exe OR *\Tailscale.exe OR *\TAILSCALE.EXE OR *\tailscaled.exe OR *\Tailscaled.exe) OR @CommandLine:(*"tailscale up"* OR *"tailscale login"* OR *--authkey* OR *--login-server*))
2693.falcon: #event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2 (ImageFileName=/\\tailscale(d)?\.exe$/i OR CommandLine=/(tailscale\s+(up|login)|--authkey|--login-server)/i) | groupBy([aid, ComputerName, UserName, ImageFileName, CommandLine], function=count())

2746.def:
let crawl4ai_lineage = dynamic(["python","python.exe","python3","python3.10","python3.11","python3.12","uvicorn","uvicorn.exe","gunicorn","sh","bash","dash","zsh"]);
let secret_markers = dynamic(["/etc/passwd","/etc/shadow","/proc/self/environ","printenv","169.254.169.254","/latest/meta-data","metadata.google.internal","169.254.170.2",".aws/credentials",".ssh/id_rsa",".kube/config",".docker/config.json"]);
let ProcHits = DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(7d)
    | where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ (crawl4ai_lineage)
         or InitiatingProcessParentFileName in~ (crawl4ai_lineage)
    | where InitiatingProcessCommandLine has_any ("crawl4ai","uvicorn","server","11235","app:app")
         or ProcessCommandLine has_any (secret_markers)
    | where ProcessCommandLine has_any (secret_markers)
    | project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName,
              ParentImage = InitiatingProcessFolderPath,
              ParentCmd = InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
              ChildImage = FolderPath,
              ChildCmd = ProcessCommandLine;
let NetHits = DeviceNetworkEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(7d)
    | where RemoteIP in ("169.254.169.254","169.254.170.2","100.100.100.200")
    | where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ (crawl4ai_lineage)
         or InitiatingProcessParentFileName in~ (crawl4ai_lineage)
    | project Timestamp, DeviceName,
              ParentImage = InitiatingProcessFolderPath,
              ParentCmd = InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
              ChildImage = "network",
              ChildCmd = strcat("net:", RemoteIP, ":", tostring(RemotePort));
union ProcHits, NetHits
| order by Timestamp desc
